result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks adjacent to commercial buildings. A significant portion of the image is blurred, obscuring potential hazards and infrastructure details on the left side of the frame.

hazards.name: Lack of tactile warnings
hazards.description: The curb ramps do not appear to have truncated domes or tactile paving for visually impaired pedestrians.

hazards.name: Image Blur
hazards.description: A large portion of the intersection and approaching roadway is obscured by a blur, preventing a full safety assessment of sightlines and traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Tactile Warning Surfaces
interventions.description: Add detectable warning pads to all curb ramps to improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and signalized control with pedestrian signals. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a long crossing distance without a median refuge, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway

hazards.name: Gas station conflict points
hazards.description: Multiple wide driveways for the gas station create frequent conflict points between pedestrians and turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the Sunoco station

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and continuous sidewalks, but lacks active traffic control signals or a pedestrian refuge. The wide roadway and presence of large vehicles like school buses increase the exposure risk for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of visible traffic control
hazards.description: No pedestrian signals or stop signs are clearly visible to regulate vehicle-pedestrian interactions at this wide crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on all corners. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the crossing points create potential visibility and exposure risks.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, near the corner grocery store.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.
